description: Every merge to main is released by .github/workflows/release.yml according to its Conventional Commit type:
fix(deps) for the runtime dependencies of the image (requirements.txt, the Dockerfile base image) releases a patch;
chore(deps) / ci(deps) for the tooling release nothing.

customManagers.description: Tool versions in the workflows, after a `# renovate: datasource=... depName=...` comment

packageRules.description: Tooling by default: chore(deps), no release
Runtime dependencies of the image: fix(deps), merging one releases a patch with a new image
GitHub Actions and the tool versions of the workflows: ci(deps), no release
Runtime dependencies except yt-dlp: one weekly pull request for the minor and patch updates
Base image digest (Debian and Python security fixes): weekly
Dev tools (requirements-dev.txt, pre-commit hooks, commitlint): one weekly pull request
ruff, black and isort are pinned twice (requirements-dev.txt and .pre-commit-config.yaml): always updated together
GitHub Actions and CI tools: one weekly pull request for the non-major updates
yt-dlp: sites break often and its fixes must ship without a human. Automerged (squash) once the required checks pass, which releases a patch
